name: return by d34th
description:
The delivery finally reached the backdoors of the Student Council, but instead of Kaicho's love, the box contained a mysterious black terminal, and out of it came a boy named Subaru.
Subaru seems to have forgotten someone important (Rem 🤧), and every wrong attempt to recover his memories leads to another RBD. Now he's asking for your help.
The tracking ID from the challenge, Love is a Secret Key (invoice), might come in handy.

**Use:**
`./parcel_delivery <TRACKING_ID>`
